statement: Complete integral wild-local central cohomology for the actual cubic pro-three full, metabelian and marked groups, with explicit obstruction matrices and every nonempty central lifting fiber.
manuscript_passages: Section51.16; folios733v-736v; scans172-178; formulas371-379; Part E(c),(d), follow-up(4)
notes: The actual local relative quotient surjects onto Gamma and has an explicitly constructed equivariant section; the finite-order complement lies in that relative quotient.
The absolute/pro-three cohomology comparison is proved from Kummer theory and the exact Brauer restriction map, followed by finite-module devissage and finite inverse limits.
H2 is the actual compact cokernel [T_r-7I | J_r+I]; its first three groups are Z3^5; Z3+C3^11+C9^4; C3^63+C9^23+C27^7.
H1 is the actual split C_r plus the saturated two-evaluation Hom lattice, of extra rank (n_r+trJ_r)/2+b_r, with all torsion retained from E41. Its first free ranks are15,46,330.
Every nonempty central section fiber is that H1 group through the literal central-difference map; all twisted lower stabilizers are trivial.

The numerical entries of the chosen extra-factor coordinate map and the individual nonlinear obstruction values are explicitly retained as unevaluated data. No full wild section classification or full-profinite transfer is asserted.
